description: One reusable prompt: the body (text with {{variable}} placeholders), the metadata a reader picks it out of a library by, and — optionally — the explicit declaration of its variables. The record is the host's data: it carries no culture, no provider and no evaluation, because PromptTemplateParser assembles the body through plain text substitution and every value the reader types is text too. A template is picked by Id, so the id has to be stable and unique inside the library. Variables is the declaration that WINS; when it is null or empty the variables are derived from the body's placeholders.
